svg.title: Personal Expense Tracker Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from Telegram input through parsing, categorization, Supabase storage, and weekly report delivery

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does expense logging through Telegram work?')
sendPrompt('How does the JavaScript expense parser work?')
sendPrompt('How does deterministic merchant categorization work?')
sendPrompt('How does AI-assisted categorization work with GPT-4.1-mini?')
sendPrompt('What does the structured JSON output from categorization look like?')
sendPrompt('How is the Supabase database structured for this expense tracker?')
sendPrompt('How does the weekly report workflow trigger in n8n?')
sendPrompt('What does the weekly spending report include?')
sendPrompt('How is the weekly report delivered back to the user on Telegram?')
